newsitem.title: USA: Lilly CEO gets $1.17-mln raise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lilly CEO gets $1.17-mln raise in 1996.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co chairman and chief executive Randall Tobias received total compensation in 1996 of $4.94 million, compared to $3.77 million in 1995, according to the drug manufacturer's proxy statement.
The roughly $1.17-million raise for Tobias came on higher base salary, bonus, other compensation and higher long-term incentive plan payouts, the Indianapolis-based company said.

He received 1996 salary of $1.1 million, a $1.15-million bonus and other compensation of $149,216. He also received compensation of $2.47 million under long-term incentive plan payouts and a $66,002 company contribution to a savings plan.
Tobias received stock options in 1996 worth 150,000 shares, compared to 300,000 shares in 1995, the proxy said.
